messages:
maria: Heads-up — after the kernel-selector tweak merged earlier today I see a p99 latency regression on A100 when we allow high max_tokens_per_batch (>= 200k).

jason: saw that too, can you paste profiling snippets?

maria: paste below. profiler shows kernel choice falling back to a generic matmul path when KV pages > ~100. note the perf numbers.
```
model: rw-medium-16b
device: A100-80GB
previous (kernel-selector v1): p50=42ms p95=120ms p99=240ms throughput=980 tok/s
after v2 (max_tokens_per_batch allowed up to 256k): p50=46ms p95=180ms p99=410ms throughput=890 tok/s
kernel log: selected_kernel=fused_gemm_kv if contiguous=true else matmul_generic
kv_pages_avg: 78 -> 142
kv_fragmentation_ratio: 0.12 -> 0.46
notes: increased mem copies, lower SM occupancy for the fused path, fallback observed 37% of batches
```

sophia: interesting — sounds like the batching heuristic is packing long sequences together which increases KV cache occupancy and fragmentation, then kernel-selector sees non-contiguous KV layout and picks slower path. did we change packing thresholds?

maria: yes — continuous batching now prefers fill-first packing for latency SLOs, so it packs many long-prompt requests into a single large batch. that increases max_kv_span per batch.

jason: quick hypothesis: fused kernels require contiguous KV frames (aligned pages). large max_tokens_per_batch increases interleaving and causes fragmentation -> triggers matmul_generic which is slower on A100 for our model shapes. L4/A10 might tolerate it differently.

infra-bot: deploy: kernel-selector v2 rolled at 2026-03-17T14:02Z by jenkins-ci :rocket:

maria: proposed mitigation (short-term): per-GPU caps for max_tokens_per_batch + reduce max_batch_items on A100/H100 to keep KV pages under ~110. experiment plan below.

jason: propose table (starting values for canary):
- A100/H100: max_tokens_per_batch=120000, max_batch_items=12
- A10: max_tokens_per_batch=180000, max_batch_items=16
- L4: max_tokens_per_batch=240000, max_batch_items=20
- T4: max_tokens_per_batch=140000, max_batch_items=14

sophia: also add a router rule: if predicted_kv_pages > 100 and model_variant in fused_kernels => cap tokens to gpu_specific_limit. we can compute predicted_kv_pages from prompt length + kv_cache_ratio.

maria: rollout snippet (canary 10% A100):
```json
{"canary": {"device_filter": "A100","percent": 10,"config": {"max_tokens_per_batch": 120000, "max_batch_items": 12}}}
```

jason: I'll spin up canary and attach perf dashboards. target: 2 hours to gather p50/p95/p99, SM util, mem throughput, kernel fallback rate. I will also capture kernel-selector decisions.

maria: thanks — after we have numbers we can iterate. if canary shows p99 drop > 20% we keep the cap and prepare a follow-up change to the packing heuristic (prefer small-long + small-short co-pack instead of many longs together).

sophia: +1 on co-packing change. also we might add a small kernel hint in the selector when fragmentation ratio > 0.3 to prefer a path that reduces copies (experimental).

jason: ack, will report back in this thread. :thumbsup:

maria: filing a short GH issue with the experiment plan and attaching these logs.
